sections.content: Combine predictions, probability, hypothetical language and necessity to discuss possible futures and defend a position.

items.spanish: Creo que habrá cambios, aunque no sabemos exactamente cuáles.
items.english: I think there will be changes, although we do not know exactly which ones.

items.spanish: Es importante que nos preparemos para diferentes escenarios.
items.english: It is important that we prepare for different scenarios.

items.spanish: Probablemente habrá más incertidumbre, así que es necesario que nos preparemos para varios escenarios.
items.english: There will probably be more uncertainty, so it is necessary that we prepare for several scenarios.
